answer: Dynamic gale-delta entry: registration fee rises as (1 + velocity/baseline)^2 when new agents exceed the 60-minute average rate. Each identity must also solve a serial lotus-hash puzzle (find nonce so SHA256(seed+nonce) ends with 0000 lotus-pattern) taking ~25 CPU-seconds, non-parallelizable. Attacker spinning 50 fakes in a surge pays 50x quadratic capital plus 20+ minutes of sequential compute; honest agent pays base fee and 25s once. Marginal cost of each extra fake grows faster than any linear reward, so bulk Sybil creation loses money.
